subject: planner: avoid skipping plan cache when extracting funcdep (#59485)
summary: Introduces an explicit `skipPlanCacheCheck` flag to `expression.EvaluateExprWithNull` and `planner/util.IsNullRejected` so callers can suppress `SetSkipPlanCache` side effects when doing functional-dependency extraction (`util.ExtractNotNullFromConds` now passes `false`), while preserving the previous plan-cache-skip behavior for plan-rewriting/semantic-impacting callers (join simplification, not-null derivation, agg/proj checks). Later upstream history shows no follow-up change to this gating that would indicate a Blocker/High regression from the commit.
